passages.text: In a medical college there are 1,600 students studying Dentistry and Homeopathy. Each student from each course knows one or more languages out of English, Hindi and Bengali. 45% of the students study Dentistry and the remaining students study Homeopathy. Out of the students studying Dentistry, boys and girls are in the ratio 5:3. Of the boys studying Dentistry, 16% know only English, 10% only Hindi, 4% only Bengali, 24% English and Hindi, 20% English and Bengali, and 14% Hindi and Bengali; the remaining boys know all three. Of the girls studying Dentistry, 20% know only English, 10% only Hindi, 10% only Bengali, 20% English and Hindi, 20% English and Bengali, and 10% Hindi and Bengali; the remaining girls know all three. Out of the students studying Homeopathy, boys and girls are in the ratio 4:7. Of the boys studying Homeopathy, 20% know only English, 15% only Hindi, 5% only Bengali, 15% English and Hindi, 25% English and Bengali, and 10% Hindi and Bengali; the remaining boys know all three. Of the girls studying Homeopathy, 15% know only English, 15% only Hindi, 5% only Bengali, 20% English and Hindi, 20% English and Bengali, and 15% Hindi and Bengali; the remaining girls know all three.

In Reliance Group there are 5,200 employees in five subsidiary companies: Reliance Retail, Reliance Life Services, Reliance Logistic, Reliance Solar and RJIL. Of all female employees, 27% work in Reliance Retail, 22% in Reliance Logistic, 16% in Reliance Life Services, and the remaining 840 female employees work in Reliance Solar. RJIL has no female employee. Of all male employees, 14% work in Reliance Retail, 30% in Reliance Logistic, 25% in Reliance Life Services, 11% in Reliance Solar, and the remaining employees work in RJIL.

questions.questionText: How many students studying Dentistry know only either English or Hindi?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.
questions.solution: Dentistry students knowing only English or only Hindi = 72 + 45 + 54 + 27 = 198.

questions.questionText: How many students in the college know all three languages?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.

questions.questionText: What percent of the total number of girls in the college know Bengali?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.
questions.solution: Girls knowing Bengali total 415 out of 830 girls. (415 / 830) x 100 = 50%.

questions.questionText: How many students studying Homeopathy do not know English?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.

questions.questionText: Among Homeopathy students, what is the ratio of boys knowing English to girls knowing Hindi?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.
questions.solution: Boys knowing English : girls knowing Hindi = 224 : 336 = 2 : 3.

questions.questionText: Of all students studying Dentistry, what percent know at least two languages?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.
questions.solution: Dentistry students knowing at least two languages = 477. (477 / 720) x 100 = 66.25%, or 66 1/4%.

questions.questionText: What percent of all girls in the college do not know Hindi, rounded to the nearest integer?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.
questions.solution: Girls not knowing Hindi total 359 out of 830 girls. (359 / 830) x 100 = 43.25%, approximately 43%.

questions.questionText: If male employees in Reliance Life Services increase by 20%, male employees in Reliance Solar increase by 25%, 60 male employees join RJIL, and male staffing in Reliance Retail and Reliance Logistic remains unchanged, what is the percentage increase in the group's male employees?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.

questions.questionText: Male employees in Reliance Logistic and Reliance Life Services together are what percent of all employees in those two firms?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.
questions.solution: Male employees = 840 + 700 = 1,540. Total employees in the two firms = 840 + 528 + 700 + 384 = 2,452. (1,540 / 2,452) x 100 = 62.8%.

questions.questionText: What is the approximate average number of employees who work in RJIL, Reliance Logistic, and Reliance Solar?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.
questions.solution: The combined employee counts are RJIL 560, Reliance Logistic 1,368, and Reliance Solar 1,148. Their average is 3,076 / 3, approximately 1,025.

questions.questionText: If equal numbers of female and male employees leave Reliance Life Services and the ratio of the remaining male to female employees becomes 149:70, how many employees left in total?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.
questions.solution: Let x men and x women leave. (700 - x) / (384 - x) = 149 / 70 gives x = 104. Therefore 208 employees leave in total.

questions.questionText: If 92 male employees are transferred from Reliance Retail to Reliance Solar and 70 female employees are transferred from Reliance Solar to Reliance Retail, what is the resulting ratio of male to female employees in Reliance Solar?
questions.directionsText: Answer by deriving information from the passage and applying the required mathematical operations.
questions.solution: Reliance Solar has 308 + 92 = 400 male employees and 840 - 70 = 770 female employees. The ratio is 400:770 = 40:77.
